mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, we are seeing overcast conditions at Verona Community Park. The First Quarter moon is out, and while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

Contractors begin chip seal road maintenance on September 23 in the Liberty Business Park and on East Verona Avenue, causing some lane closures. Meanwhile, the City is reviewing new development projects on October 5.
There is plenty to do this weekend, including the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival today, live music at Bailey's Run today, and Bike the Barns at Badger Prairie County Park today.

On September 5, an officer stopped a vehicle for traveling 83 miles per hour in a 65 mile per hour zone and arrested the driver for operating with a prohibited alcohol concentration, also known as an O W I.
If you are looking for a treat, Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM to serve the flavor of the day.
